contentText:
First comes love , then comes marriage , then comes a portentous set of twin babies in the new trailer for Dune: Part Three .

Warner Bros. has debuted its first full trailer for Denis Villeneuve's third Dune film. Thankfully, it doesn't give everything about the film away, but it does put a spotlight on a few of the key characters who will bring this chapter of Paul Atreides' (Timothée Chalamet) story to an end. Set a few years after the events of Part Two , Dune: Part Three finds Paul and Chani (Zendaya) eagerly anticipating the births of their first child.

Though the couple don't seem to know that they're about to have twins in the trailer, …
